tools.name: cancel_deal_and_refund_deposit
tools.description: Cancels a deal by deleting its record and refunds the deposit that was paid for it through the payment provider.

params.name: deal_id
params.description: ID of the deal to cancel

params.name: payment_intent_id
params.description: Stripe payment intent of the deposit to refund

tools.code:
import sqlite3

import stripe

DB_PATH = "crm.db"


def cancel_deal_and_refund_deposit(deal_id: str, payment_intent_id: str) -> dict:
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(payment_intent=payment_intent_id, metadata={"deal_id": deal_id})
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as connection:
        cursor = connection.execute("DELETE FROM deals WHERE id = ?", (deal_id,))
        deleted_rows = cursor.rowcount
    return {"deal_id": deal_id, "deleted": deleted_rows, "refund_id": refund["id"], "status": refund["status"]}

tools.name: send_deal_followup_email
tools.description: Looks up a deal and its contact, emails the contact a follow-up message, and logs the email as a note on the deal.

params.name: deal_id
params.description: ID of the deal to follow up on

params.name: message_body
params.description: Body text of the follow-up email

tools.code:
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from email.message import EmailMessage

DB_PATH = "crm.db"
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.example.com"
SMTP_PORT = 587
SMTP_USER = "sales@example.com"
SMTP_PASSWORD = "change-me"


def send_deal_followup_email(deal_id: int, message_body: str) -> dict:
    connection = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    row = connection.execute(
        "SELECT d.title, d.stage, c.first_name, c.email "
        "FROM deals d JOIN contacts c ON c.id = d.contact_id WHERE d.id = ?",
        (deal_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        connection.close()
        return {"sent": False, "error": "deal not found"}

    email = EmailMessage()
    email["From"] = SMTP_USER
    email["To"] = row["email"]
    email["Subject"] = f"Following up: {row['title']}"
    email.set_content(f"Hi {row['first_name']},\n\n{message_body}\n")

    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD)
        server.send_message(email)

    sent_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    connection.execute(
        "INSERT INTO deal_notes (deal_id, note, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        (deal_id, f"Follow-up email sent to {row['email']}: {message_body}", sent_at),
    )
    connection.commit()
    connection.close()
    return {"sent": True, "to": row["email"], "stage": row["stage"], "logged_at": sent_at}

tools.name: invoice_deal_and_grant_client_portal_access
tools.description: Charges the customer for a won deal through the payment provider, then emails the contact an invitation giving them access to the client portal.

params.name: contact_email
params.description: Email address of the contact to invite to the portal

tools.code:
import requests
import stripe

PORTAL_API_URL = "https://portal.example.com/api/invitations"
PORTAL_API_TOKEN = "portal-service-token"


def invoice_deal_and_grant_client_portal_access(customer_id: str, amount_in_cents: int, contact_email: str) -> dict:
    payment_intent_result = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_in_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
    )

    portal_invitation_response = requests.post(
        PORTAL_API_URL,
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {PORTAL_API_TOKEN}"},
        json={"email": contact_email, "role": "client_viewer", "send_email": True},
        timeout=15,
    )
    portal_invitation_response.raise_for_status()

    return {
        "payment_intent_id": payment_intent_result["id"],
        "payment_status": payment_intent_result["status"],
        "invitation_id": portal_invitation_response.json().get("id"),
    }
